metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.5 · 2012 · Tiger & Bunny the Movie: The Beginning
metas.description: Set on an alternative Earth, Superheroes are celebrities and a high rating TV show rates their achievements, awarding them points until an annual King of Heroes is crowned. Old-school hero Wild Tiger is assigned a new partner with very different views on the heroes role in society but soon a vigilante criminal presents them with a serious problem.
